title: Punchy Puncher
body:
"Knocks skeletons apart and sends goblins flying. Pure chaos in your hands. for some reason the glove is the wrong way"

Description

The Punchy Puncher resembles a Grabby Grabber but with the top part removed and replaced with a boxing glove. it is the Starter weapon available for purchase for $5,600. It deals close to 1 damage but does considerable knockback roughly triple of what the Rust Breaker does, it has low cooldown.

Like all other starter weapons, it is available without completing The Arena.

While it is useless at killing enemies and at completing the Arena, the Puncher can be helpful at launching enemies off of cliffs or into other hazards.

Trivia

The description "for some reason the glove is the wrong way" is correct as this is a left-hand glove but when you equip it, it is on the right hand. this could be some inside joke or it's because the grabbers are modeled and animated on the right hand and the glove was designed left-handed.
